summary:
We have developed a comic book for 5th-grade students. Our aim is to satisfy their curiosity about space and help them understand the importance of space vehicles.​

The challenge is that there are only a limited number of comic books that 5th-grade students can both understand and enjoy. This comic book is important because it helps prevent students from losing their curiosity about space.​

With its enjoyable illustrations and easy-to-understand sentences, it is an ideal comic book for 5th-grade students.
details:
• Our project provides 5th-grade students with an opportunity to experience a comic book digitally.​
  • ​It satisfies children's curiosity about space and helps them understand the importance of space vehicles.​
  • Satisfying their curiosity about space.
